title: AuthProvider::auth_header returns String, not HeaderValue
description: auth_header() returns Option<(&'static str, String)> rather than Option<(HeaderName, HeaderValue)>. This is intentional pre-1.0: avoids locking the API to reqwest or http crate types. The WS path performs explicit validation via http::HeaderValue::from_str, and the HTTP path relies on reqwest's handling. The asymmetry is documented in the trait's contract comment. Changing to HeaderValue would be a breaking API change.
